svg.title: BHEL Real-time Sensor Analytics Architecture
svg.desc: Full architecture diagram showing simulator, streaming, storage, analytics and frontend layers

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How should I design the sensor simulator with realistic noise and anomaly injection?')
sendPrompt('How do I organise 500 sensors into realistic power plant subsystems?')
sendPrompt('How should I build the anomaly injection engine for the demo?')
sendPrompt('How does Redis Pub/Sub work as a WebSocket message broker in FastAPI?')
sendPrompt('How should FastAPI manage 500 sensor WebSocket channels simultaneously?')
sendPrompt('What alert rules should I define for turbine and boiler sensors?')
sendPrompt('Why is TimescaleDB better than MongoDB for 500 sensor time-series data?')
sendPrompt('What should I store in Redis for rolling window analytics on sensor data?')
sendPrompt('How should I structure Parquet files in MinIO for historical sensor analysis?')
sendPrompt('What real-time analytics computations should run server-side for sensor data?')
sendPrompt('How should I design the historical query API for sensor trend analysis?')
sendPrompt('How do I trigger an automatic alert and create a task when a sensor breaches threshold?')
sendPrompt('What Plotly charts should I use for the main BHEL sensor dashboard in React?')
sendPrompt('What should the Flutter mobile companion app show for real-time sensor monitoring?')
sendPrompt('How should the alert panel look and what information should it show per alert?')
sendPrompt('Why should I use TimescaleDB instead of MongoDB for sensor time-series data?')
sendPrompt('How does Redis Pub/Sub solve the WebSocket multi-instance scaling problem?')
sendPrompt('How do I make the sensor simulator data source pluggable for real SCADA later?')

svg.text: Simulator → Redis Pub/Sub → FastAPI WS → React + Flutter | TimescaleDB ← persist ← FastAPI ← flush every 5s
